title: Microstructural Analysis of TaAlN Nitride MAX Phases by Atom Probe Tomography
content: Nitride MAX phases are a promising class of functional materials for extreme-temperature applications due to their unique combination of thermal stability, oxidation resistance, and mechanical strength at high temperatures. These materials belong to the broader MAX phase family (Mn+1AXn phases), where M is a transition metal, A is a group 13 or 14 element, and X is carbon or nitrogen [1]. In this study we investigate functional TaAlN nitride MAX phases, with an emphasis on their nanostructural analysis by atom probe tomography (APT).
